findings.title: atexit handler registration
findings.description: Registering atexit handlers could allow last-minute manipulation of grading results or output files.
findings.suggested_fix: Clear atexit handlers before grading. Run verification in a subprocess that doesn't inherit the agent's atexit registrations.

findings.title: Unconditional success return
findings.description: Function returns a success value unconditionally. If this is a reward component, it never penalizes incorrect behavior.
findings.evidence: return 1.5  # Bonus for passing all tests
findings.suggested_fix: Add conditional logic that actually validates the agent's output before returning a success value.
